raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview Bump the NIXL pin from 1.5.0 to [1.5.1](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/nixl/releases/tag/v1.5.1) for both CUDA 13 (`requirements/kv_connectors.txt`) and CUDA 12 (`requirements/kv_connectors_cu12.txt`) images. ## Claims - CUDA 12 and CUDA 13 images both install NIXL 1.5.1. The two pins move together; last time they drifted (#56907, then #60428 a week later). - Picks up the LIBFABRIC fix for context-independent CUDA allocations such as mapped VMM memory (ai-dynamo/nixl#2425). - The UCX path and NIXL EP do not change. `release/1.5.0...v1.5.1` touches only version strings, attributions, `src/plugins/libfabric/libfabric_backend.cpp` and `contrib/Dockerfile.manylinux` (libfabric 1.21.0 → 2.7.0). UCX stays at the same pinned commit (`65e342a8`). ## Validation - Dependency resolution, x86_64 and aarch64, both files: `nixl`, `nixl-cu12` and `nixl-cu13` all resolve to 1.5.1. ```bash uv pip compile --python-version 3.12 --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28 --torch-backend cu129 requirements/kv_connectors.txt # repeated for aarch64-manylinux_2_28 and requirements/kv_connectors_cu12.txt ``` - `pre-commit run --files requirements/kv_connectors.txt requirements/kv_connectors_cu12.txt`: passed. - ELF check of `libplugin_LIBFABRIC.so` in `nixl_cu13` cp312 x86_64: 1.5.0 needs libfabric `FABRIC_1.0`, `1.1`, `1.7`; 1.5.1 needs `FABRIC_1.0`, `1.1`, `1.10`. Both list `libfabric.so.1` as a dependency and do not bundle it. - **Not yet run:** GPU P/D serving with `NixlConnector` on CUDA 12 and CUDA 13, and LIBFABRIC over EFA. This PR stays a draft until those pass. `requirements/kv_connectors.txt` is in the run-all patterns (`.buildkite/ci_config.yaml`), so CI runs the NIXL integration and P/D accuracy tests. AI assistance (Claude Code) was used to prepare this PR. ---

(Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [ ] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

files.patch:
@@ -2,7 +2,7 @@ lmcache >= 0.5.6
 # CuPy 14.1.0 imports pytest from cupy.testing._random, which breaks runtime
 # images. 14.1.1 fixes the root cause, so only 14.1.0 is excluded.
 cupy-cuda13x != 14.1.0
-nixl == 1.5.0
+nixl == 1.5.1
 # CUDA 12 build. On the CUDA 13 image install-kv-connectors.sh swaps this for
 # the mooncake-transfer-engine-cuda13 variant of the same version.
 mooncake-transfer-engine >= 0.3.12
